name: Stipends To Trainees In Industrial Training Institute
benefit:
₹60/- per month will be given to student residing in the hostel of the organization Department of Technical Education.
₹ 40/- per month will be given by the Social welfare department to student residing in the hostel of the organization Department of Technical Education.
₹100/- per month will be given by the social welfare department to those student who do not get anything from the organization's
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Maharashtra.
1. The student should belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
1. It is mandatory for the student should take training in a recognized Industrial Training Institute.
1. The annual income of the applicant’s father should not be more than ₹ 65290/-.
